items.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
items.description: Rates were hiked in a unanimous decision despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had called for a cut.

items.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
items.description: A wrecked air force plane and destroyed buildings are among the images obtained by the BBC's partner CBS News.

items.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
items.description: Canada is seeking closer ties with EU after a breakdown in relations with the US and its president Donald Trump.

items.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
items.description: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

items.title: US House votes to hold billionaire Epstein associate Leon Black in contempt
items.description: Black - who had business ties to Epstein - declined to appear and provide documents related to the convicted sex offender.

items.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
items.description: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.

items.title: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
items.description: Christian Democratic Union leadership throws its weight behind the chancellor ahead of two state elections this weekend.

items.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
items.description: The Houthis deny targeting the Islamic holy city after the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen accuses them of a "disgraceful act".

items.title: Trump chief of staff Susie Wiles announces she's cancer-free
items.description: The 69-year-old White House chief of staff is a powerful figure and particularly close to the US president.

items.title: Michelin-starred Seoul restaurant fined for using ants as garnish
items.description: The owner of the acclaimed establishment avoids jail but is made to pay 15 million won (£8,144; $10,965).

items.title: Charlie Kirk's family alleges 'stunning failures' by Utah officials led to his shooting
items.description: The conservative activist was speaking to a crowd of thousands on the university campus when he was shot and killed by a gunman positioned on a roof.

items.title: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
items.description: The two countries accounted for 52% of killings of environmental activists in 2025, according to Global Witness.
